title: DaliCam
summary: Gemini/OpenAI powered capture, gallery, edit/generate with preset artist
description:
DaliCam is a device-first CardputerZero app for capturing photos, uploading test 
 images, browsing galleries, and generating new images with Gemini and OpenAI     
 image models. It includes an on-device prompt workflow, a browser-based WebUI on 
 port 8080, remote capture, day-grouped galleries, per-image management tools,    
 and a custom preset workflow for testing and everyday use. To access the WebUI   
 from a PC or phone on the same network, open a browser and go to                 
 http://<device-ip>:8080, replacing <device-ip> with the CardputerZero’s local IP 
 address. Found in IP PANEL.
